facts.fact: Official Gazette General Notice No. 985 of 2025 records the President appointing an eight-member Board of the Seychelles Bureau of Standards for three years from 1 August 2025, under section 5 of the Seychelles Bureau of Standards Act 2014 as last amended by Act 16 of 2021; the notice names no standard.

note: Board appointment notice dated 18 September 2025 (effective 1 August 2025); it states a body exists but no IT or data standard and no certification.

SADCAS register lists accreditations of the Bureau's mass calibration, chemical testing and others (non-IT, accreditation of laboratories, not certification against an IT or data standard); class other, no fact. The register names the Bureau only as an accredited body, not as having issued a standard.

facts.fact: SeyLII's record of the Seychelles Bureau of Standards Act, 2014 (Act 2 of 2014) shows it repealing the earlier Bureau of Standards Act, commenced 16 June 2014 and amended in 2016 and 2021; only the citation and history page is captured, not the Act's text.

note: Citation page only; no IT or data standard and no certification stated.

facts.fact: The Seychelles Bureau of Standards Act, 2014 (Act 2 of 2014, assented 28 March 2014, repealing the 1987 Act) establishes the Seychelles Bureau of Standards as a body corporate (s.3) with the function of preparing draft standards and declaring them Seychelles Standards by Gazette notice (s.4(b), s.14); the Act commences on a date the Minister appoints by Gazette notice, which this text does not give.

systems.owner: Government of Seychelles (body corporate under the Minister responsible for Industry)

note: No standard on information technology or data is named, so no published fact; the Bureau's power to assess and certify manufacturing, process or management systems (s.4(e)) and to authorise a Standard Mark (s.20) names no IT or data standard and no certified organisation, so no certification fact.

facts.fact: The Seychelles Bureau of Standards was established as a government agency under the SBS Act 1987 and is to develop, declare and promote Seychelles Standards; no information technology standard is named.

note: An ISO 9001 quality management certificate for the Meteorological Authority from BSI, a certifier abroad; no national standards body or IT standard is stated.
